items.problem: Migration was declared without the mandatory Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 gate passing — the app did not build, which the validator's Section 6 build healthcheck would have flagged.
items.evidence: migration-score.json winui_buildable=false while the trial ended; build never reached green.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md > Step 4 — Validate (mandatory before declaring done): '🛑 You are NOT done until Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 reports PASS' and Section 6 'dotnet build healthcheck — clean build'.
items.why_no_skill_change: The skill already prominently and repeatedly mandates the validate gate and a clean build before declaring done; a capable model on re-run that runs the gate would not have shipped a non-building app. The underlying missing-types cause is fixed by the bootstrap harvest; the failure to run the gate is a pure process slip, not a skill deficiency.
